note: alpha_corrected = asymmetry(mask, align='corrected'); alpha_published = asymmetry(mask, align='published') (the cached/paper metric). throughput = area / reference_circle_area_px. Demo percentage = alpha_corrected / (1/3) * 100.
scale_caveat: The theoretical max over CONVEX shapes is 1/3, but these masks are RASTERIZED polygons on a 128x128 grid, so discretization lets a few exceed it: 50/1500 (3.33%) of the test pool have alpha_corrected > 1/3, up to 0.353933 = 106.18% of the scale. Clamp the demo slider's displayed percentage to 100, or use alpha_display_max below instead of 1/3.
